title: Mega menu
notes: Augments the real Squarespace header nav. Hand-built rather than converted: focus handling and ARIA are not safe to machine-translate from React. DESKTOP ONLY BY DESIGN — hidden below 768px, because Squarespace's mobile nav is a separate overlay DOM that this component does not touch. Mobile visitors get the site's normal menu, which is the correct fallback, not a bug.

options.menus: array of { match, columns: [{ title, links: [{label, href, description}] }] }
options.trigger: hover|click (default hover, always click on touch)
